articles.headline: Monaco add USMNT's Balogun to Conference League squad after goal
articles.description: United States striker Folarin Balogun has been added to Monaco's squad for the Conference League, having originally been left out amid uncertainty over his future.

images.name: Balogun action vs Paris FC_261101 [1296x729]
images.caption: Folarin Balogun has been added to Monaco's Conference League squad after initially being left out.
images.alt: Folarin Balogun has been added to Monaco's Conference League squad after initially being left out.

articles.headline: Brighton held by Jablonec in as winning run ends in Conference League
articles.description: Brighton drew a rare blank as they were held to a goalless draw by Czech minnows Jablonec in the Conference League.

images.name: Promise David of Brighton & Hove Albion [1296x729]

articles.headline: André Onana concedes direct from corner, saves penalty, as Mo Salah scores again
articles.description: André Onana endured a rollercoaster performance for Trabzonspor on Thursday in the Conference League.

articles.headline: Rutter sends message to Hürzeler with brace as Brighton cruise past Kauno Zalgiris
articles.description: Georginio Rutter got Brighton's Conference League campaign off to a flying start and sent a message to boss Fabian Hürzeler.

images.name: Georginio Rutter [1296x729]
images.credit: Photo by Steve Bardens - AMA/Getty Images

articles.headline: Folarin Balogun omitted from Monaco Conference League squad after Everton saga
articles.description: Folarin Balogun has been left out of Monaco's squad for the Conference League amid uncertainty over his future after the collapse of his proposed transfer to Everton.

images.name: Balogun [1296x729]
images.credit: (Photo by Valery HACHE / AFP via Getty Images)

images.name: Hislop has 'no sympathy' for Everton over Balogun transfer saga
images.caption: Hislop has 'no sympathy' for Everton over Balogun transfer saga

keyEvents.text: Albian Hajdari (Lugano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Celje 1, Lugano 0. Tamar Svetlin (Celje) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Logan Delaurier-Chaubet with a through ball.
Substitution, Celje. Marco Dulca replaces Mario Kvesic.
Armandas Kucys (Celje) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Mattia Bottani (Lugano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lugano. Kacper Przybylko replaces Georgios Koutsias.
Substitution, Celje. Damjan Vuklisevic replaces Lukasz Bejger because of an injury.
Substitution, Lugano. Yanis Cimignani replaces Mattia Bottani.
Substitution, Celje. Edmilson replaces Armandas Kucys.
Substitution, Celje. Nino Kouter replaces Tamar Svetlin.
Antonios Papadopoulos (Lugano) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Klemen Nemanic (Celje) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lugano. Ayman El Wafi replaces Renato Steffen.
Substitution, Lugano. Daniel Dos Santos replaces Milton Valenzuela.
